title: I made a survival game where losing one person ends your run. Chapter 1 is out (free, playable in browser)
author: Critical-Truth-3404
selftext:
Hi fellow gamers,

I just hit that publish button on itch.

I’ve been working on this game for a while, and I finally got the first chapter out

It’s a top-down survival game. During the day, you go out into the dead city and search for food and supplies and in the night you feed the survivors.

Chapter 1 takes around 30m for me. But to be honest I have played this 1000 times but I think still you can complete this in less than an hour.

I’d genuinely love to know how people get on with it. How far did you make it? Was there a particular moment that made you stop? Even if you got bored after a couple of days, I’d like to know.

If you want to send feedback while playing, press B or use the Feedback option in the pause menu. It’ll send me a message along with a screenshot of where you were in the game.

You can play it here (completely free, no download needed):  
[https://warlordvii.itch.io/found-by-dusk](https://warlordvii.itch.io/found-by-dusk)

I made sure to make a webGL build so most people can play it.

It would mean a lot to me if you play this game.

Thank you so much

comments.author: thecrownforge
comments.body: with one death ending the whole run, i would want the end screen to show the last food choice and what led to the death. otherwise a new player may only see that they lost, not what to try differently next time. does the game show that chain clearly?

replies.author: Critical-Truth-3404
replies.body:
So it’s not the food that kills you like you are suppose to save people and bring them home.. and if there is not enough food the people die. And once people is dead you can start with the save.. it’s more of a story game. But you lose if someone died either with hunger or getting attacked by zombies. And yes it shows the chain like why your game is over.  
Thanks for playing though
